verses.verse:
अनामिकाम् समुत्थाय द्वितीयो नाद उच्यते।
मध्यमाम् तु समुत्थाप्य तृतीयो नाद्यते खलु।८३।
verses.text: By lifting the ring finger the second sound is said [to arise]; by lifting the middle finger the third is indeed sounded.

commentary.text: That is, opening the lowest hole produces the second sound, and opening the second hole the third.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
